resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a standard biometric update because at least one candidate from the resident's own parent Aadhaar was adjudicated a false positive while other same-parent candidates matched as true duplicates, leaving the parent's records inconsistently confirmed.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a biometric update, which must authenticate against every historical iteration of their own parent Aadhaar. Some iterations of that parent matched completely while at least one was marked a false positive, so the authentication was inconsistent and the packet was rejected. The false-positive marking on the resident's own records needs correcting, after which the packet can be replayed.
